_comment: Input for scripts/fill_template.py. Keys are the placeholder names. Required: GAME_NAME, GENRE, SETTING_SHORT, ONE_PARAGRAPH_PITCH, TAGLINE, DEV_PORT, PREVIEW_PORT, GITHUB_REMOTE. Optional keys show their defaults or an example; delete any optional key to use the default. Keys starting with _ are ignored. QUESTIONS.md says which answer fills which key.
SETTING_SHORT: set on storm-wracked sky islands with a hopeful adventure tone
ONE_PARAGRAPH_PITCH: Lead a small crew of sky-sailors from island to island through a storm that never ends. Every fight happens on a tiny grid where the wind shoves everyone one tile each round, so positioning is everything. Between runs you rebuild your harbour and unlock new crew.
TAGLINE: a tactics roguelite on sky islands where the storm moves everyone.
TRAILER_LEDE: Sail a crew of sky-sailors through an endless storm. The wind shoves every unit each round, so the right tile wins the fight.
SIM_SYSTEMS: grid combat, wind push, island generation, crew, harbour meta
PLAYTEST_AREAS: first minutes, combat readability, wind push, island map, crew and losses, boss, harbour meta, phone, fun
